reading_note: The teaching unfolds the doctrine of the Grand Man: the entire spiritual cosmos exists in the form of a human, because love and wisdom in their ultimate organization take human form. It begins by mapping the universe of being onto the body — head as celestial degree, neck-to-heart as spiritual degree, heart-to-thighs as natural-rational degree, thighs-to-feet as sensual/ultimate degree — then traces the four watches as four discrete states of governance over creation, the five sentinels as the five degrees of reception, the twelve zodiacal signs as the complete circuit of all affections-of-truth distributed through right (good) and left (truth) sides of the spiritual man, and finally the multitudes of governing principles within the body that, when evil is conquered, are expelled with their illnesses and the wounds healed. The single arc: spiritual reality is human in form, organized through discrete degrees, governed by watches of divine providence, completing its circuit through twelve states, and finally purged of its disorders by the regenerating Mind of Light and the New Man.
